text:
olivia chen: Ran the new quantized-t5 eval 3x and seeing different generations across runs with the same seed. suspicious.

ryan choi: wait — same seed + same model artifact?

olivia chen: yes. committed model hash: `sha256:9f3a...c12`. I export the artifact from the bring-up job and reuse the same weights.

olivia chen: sample outputs:
```
run A: "The patient was diagnosed with pneumonia and started antibiotics."
run B: "The patient was diagnosed with pneumona and started antibiotics."
```
only one character off but BLEU/EM scores flip in our CI.

sachin patil: tiny tokenization diffs can cascade when sampling at temp>0. Are you sure tokenization is identical between runner binary and tokenizer pip package?

olivia chen: that's my suspicion. Our docker image pins `transformers==4.32.1` but the model bundle ships a tokenizer.json built with a newer tokenizers runtime.

emma li: can you paste tokenizer versions and a quick repro script?

olivia chen: repro snippet:
```
# inside eval container
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('local_bundle').get_vocab_size())"
# pip freeze
transformers==4.32.1
tokenizers==0.12.1
```

olivia chen: on dev host: tokenizers==0.13.2 and vocab_size differs by 1.

ryan choi: that's huge. Token id mismatch -> different sampling trajectories even with same RNG. Not an RNG bug.

sachin patil: we should do two things: 1) make the runner validate tokenizer hash in model metadata; 2) add a lightweight deterministic tokenization test in CI that decodes->encodes and checks ids.

emma li: agree. Also add an eval harness check that runs the same seed for 3 runs and asserts string-equality for temp=0 (greedy) and tokenization-stable for temp>0 (maybe id sequence equal).

olivia chen: patch idea: model bundle includes `tokenizer_hash` computed at bundle time. Runner on start:
```
if bundle.tokenizer_hash != runtime.tokenizer.hash():
  warn and fail CI unless env ALLOW_TOKENIZER_MISMATCH=1
```

ryan choi: +automated fix: during bring-up CI step convert tokenizer to canonical format we use (tokenizers==0.13.2) and commit a regenerated `tokenizer.json`. That avoids runtime surprises.

eval-bot: Eval job 1843000001 started (quantized-t5, x1).

olivia chen: For immediate mitigation I re-ran the failing CI with a container that pins tokenizers==0.13.2 and the metric diff disappeared. So it's reproducible.

emma li: can you open a PR that: 1) adds the tokenizer hash check to runner; 2) adds a CI gating job that runs the tokenization roundtrip check; 3) documents allowed mismatch policy for private deployments. Keep changes small and feature-flagged.

olivia chen: will do. also adding a note to onboarding checklist: "rebuild tokenizer with target tokenizers runtime".

sachin patil: one more gotcha: quantized kernels sometimes reorder ops which can change whitespace normalization in our fast tokenizers. add a deterministic normalization step in the eval harness: `normalize_text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text).replace('\u00A0',' ')`.

ryan choi: good call. that should reduce noise from encoding differences.

emma li: thanks team. filing follow-ups:
- olivia: PR w/ runner check + CI job (ETA EOD)
- sachin: add normalization util and doc (ETA tomorrow)
- ryan: script to regenerate canonical tokenizer.json for bundles (ETA EOD)

olivia chen: filing PR now. will tag you all. :rocket:
